bus.via: Delhi ISBT Kashmiri Gate to Agra

trips.route_note: Take a fast Gatimaan or Shatabdi express train from New Delhi's Hazrat Nizamuddin or New Delhi station directly to Agra Cantt, then a short auto-rickshaw ride to the Taj Mahal area.
trips.tour_query: Taj Mahal day trip from Delhi
trips.why: Fast express trains reach Agra Cantt in 1h 50m, far quicker than the 3h 28m bus, with a short auto ride to the Taj.
know: Taj Mahal is closed to tourists on Fridays
Book train tickets ahead, especially in peak season
Go at sunrise for fewer crowds and better light

trips.route_note: Frequent local and express trains run from New Delhi and Hazrat Nizamuddin to Mathura Junction in under two hours; Vrindavan is a short auto-rickshaw ride away.
trips.tour_query: Mathura Vrindavan day trip from Delhi
trips.why: Frequent trains reach Mathura Junction in 1h 19m versus 3h 35m by bus, with Vrindavan a short auto ride away.
know: Major temples are busiest during Holi and Janmashtami festivals
Some temples close during afternoon hours
Start early to combine Mathura and Vrindavan in one day
